result.quote: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
result.reason: Verse 26:4 directly and uniquely identifies how Uzziah followed Amaziah’s example. Although verse 26:5 says Uzziah sought God, it does not attribute that conduct to Amaziah’s example. The edited item narrows the answer from the source pair’s two-part scope (“did what was right” and “seek God”) to only the first fact, so the original target was changed.
